hook.text: Two-photon lithography prints structures smaller than a human hair.

buildup.text: A focused laser cures resin at a single point in 3D space.

discovery.text: Nanoscribe's printers produce micro-lenses, scaffolds for cell growth, and microfluidic devices for medical diagnostics.

twist.text: These micro-parts could power drug-delivery robots smaller than a blood cell that navigate the body to deliver medicine.

climax.text: Researchers printed the world's smallest boat: 30 micrometers long.

punchline.text: The smallest things might make the biggest difference.
